name: types
description: Shared RefineTuple type used by every refiner. Installed automatically as a dependency.

name: password-match-refiner
description: Intended for confirmation fields such as `confirmPassword`. When the values differ, the validation error is assigned to the confirmation field rather than the original field.

name: strong-password-refiner
description: Validates a configurable password-strength policy (length, character classes, whitespace, repeating characters) and reports the first rule that fails.

name: date-range-refiner
description: Validates that an end date comes after a start date, with configurable equality, date-vs-datetime granularity, and error placement.

name: allowed-domains-refiner
description: Validates that a string is a URL or email address with a domain that is in an allowed list, with optional subdomain support.
